summary: NIO Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC providing its May 2026 delivery update, a routine monthly operational report. There is no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is a standard disclosure of monthly sales figures for a foreign private issuer, not an event-driven special situation.
